Chapter 222: Chapter 16 Identity Revealed (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 222: Chapter 16 Identity Revealed (Please Subscribe)

“Since Mr. Lin has already stepped into the Sixth Rank, I will take my leave,”

The dwarfish man bowed slightly towards Lin Yuan and disappeared on the spot.

He had been commanded by the Goddess of Wisdom to protect Lin Yuan until he reached the Sixth Rank.

Now that Lin Yuan had indeed reached the Sixth Rank, his mission was considered complete.

And, considering that Lin Yuan and the bald, burly man, the two martial brothers, obviously had things to discuss, his staying would only make things awkward for himself.

“So he was a King from the Demonic Mouse Race?”

...

The elder martial brother glanced at the departing dwarfish man and spoke softly.

“The Demonic Mouse Race?”

“A King?”

A thought flickered in Lin Yuan’s heart.

He knew about the Demonic Mouse Race, which had submitted to the Human Race a million years ago and had long since been integrated.

The fact that the Goddess of Wisdom had assigned this dwarfish man to protect him clearly showed her absolute trust in the man.

In fact, these Different Species who had been integrated into Human Civilization for so long might be even more loyal to Human Civilization than some from the Human Race.

Their relatives and tribe members all resided within the territory of Human Civilization.

If they ever dared to betray, all of their kin would suffer the consequences.

As for a King… that was a title for a Seventh-Rank Peak Evolver.

Contrary to the divisions of the First to Sixth Ranks into twelve segments each,

Seventh Rank Evolvers only had three stages.

From weakest to strongest, they were Duke, Marquis, and King.

The King level in the Seventh Rank was already at the Seventh-Rank Peak, and even in the Battlefields of Different Races, a King could dominate an area alone.

“Thank you, elder martial brother, for your protection during this time…”

Lin Yuan spoke earnestly. He had realized the moment he saw his elder martial brother how confident he had been when Lin Yuan had asked him how to guard against the Black Prison.

It was why his elder martial brother had confidently told Lin Yuan to train on the Canglan Star.

“We’re martial brothers, why the thanks?”

The elder martial brother waved his hand.

“Let’s go.”

“Little brother, take advantage of the fact that the news of your breakthrough to the Sixth Rank hasn’t spread yet and come back with me to the Chikun Main Star,” the elder martial brother suddenly said, as if he had thought of something.

The dwarfish man from the Demonic Mouse Race knew Lin Yuan had reached the Sixth Rank, but he definitely wouldn’t spread the word.

Therefore, up to now,

Others were unaware of Lin Yuan’s breakthrough to the Sixth Rank.

Even the several Fifth Rank Evolvers on the Canglan Star couldn’t sense the subtle fluctuation of a Fifth Rank breaking into the Sixth Rank.

“Alright.”

Lin Yuan nodded, glanced at the Canglan Star, and said, “We…”

“You’re wondering how to get to the Chikun Main Star, right?”

The elder martial brother smiled subtly, “If it were just me, I would take a leisurely trip back by spaceship.”

“But with the little martial brother here, to avoid unnecessary complications, let’s teleport directly back.”

The elder martial brother finished speaking,

and suddenly, a five-colored transparent crystal appeared before him.

The crystal, shaped like a ‘magic cube’, faintly emitted slight space fluctuations.

“This magic cube…”

Lin Yuan felt that the magic cube closely resembled the giant magic cube in the Seven Star Cave World that represented surpassing the Sixth Rank Evolutionary Path.

The two must share the same origin.

“This is called the Crystal Magic Cube, given by our mentor. Once crushed, it will form a space passage, and the other side leads to the Chikun Main Star,” the elder martial brother said with a grin.

Click.

The elder martial brother grasped the Crystal Magic Cube and gently squeezed.

The Crystal Magic Cube immediately crumbled into powder.

Amid the countless powdered particles, the power of space began to gather.

In front of the elder martial brother, a door of space formed.

“Go ahead, little martial brother.”

The elder martial brother closed his eyes and felt briefly, “The space passage is very stable, strong enough for a Sixth Rank Life to pass through.”

“Elder martial brother.”

Lin Yuan looked down at the Canglan Star.

“Are you worried about your family?”

The elder martial brother chuckled, “Rest assured, once you return to the main star, we will immediately announce your identity on the Chenxi Mainstar, and then Chenxi Mainstar will make the announcement externally.”

“The moment Chenxi Mainstar receives the news, they will dispatch a specialized Guard Troop to Canglan Star to protect the family of our little martial brother,” said the elder martial brother, pausing for a moment before continuing, “Actually, you needn’t worry about you family’s safety.”

“Different Species like to assassinate our Human Race’s talented Evolvers, but they are actually not that interested in the families of talented Evolvers,” the elder martial brother hinted.

“Not that interested?”

Lin Yuan was surprised.

“Let’s say, hypothetically,” the elder martial brother smiled and said, “If your family were to be assassinated by a Different Species, would you be utterly devastated?”

“No,” Lin Yuan shook his head.

“I see,” Lin Yuan realized.

High-Rank Evolvers possessed power capable of destroying heavens and earth, and naturally, their mental state was almost at Perfection.

If the death of family members could cause a High-Rank Evolver’s mental state to collapse, then all those years of cultivation would have been in vain.

The death of family members would only incite deeper hatred against the Different Species in an Evolver.

Particularly for genius-level Evolvers, the death of a relative might even act as a catalyst, helping them to break through faster.

What about capturing family members as a threat?

Throughout the long centuries of Human Civilization, no Evolver had ever yielded to threats from Different Species.

Therefore, unless under special circumstances, Different Species generally wouldn’t target the families of Human Race geniuses, as it held no practical significance.

“Go ahead.”

Lin Yuan took one last look at the Canglan Star beneath his feet and followed his elder martial brother into the space passage before him.

“Such chaotic space power,” Lin Yuan was somewhat surprised; even with a space passage to shield him, he could still feel the wildly violent space power.

This level of chaos and ferocity far surpassed what Lin Yuan had sensed in the Divine Arms World when he last entered that spatial rift.

But now,

All the turbulent and disordered space power was blocked by the space channel formed by the Crystal Magic Cube.

“Space Rules, too miraculous…”
